card.name: Modifier right before a generic noun like drugs
card.fires_on: A modifier or the end of a drug name just before a generic noun such as drugs, products, therapies, tools or formulations. Seen in drug-interaction and switching sections.

modes.label: Determiner before drugs
modes.description: Words like other, these or two that point back to drugs just named and come right before drugs or products.
modes.example: concomitant use of Ondansetron Injection and<< other>> serotonergic drugs

modes.label: End of drug name before formulations
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name in a switching heading, followed by formulations.

modes.label: Topic word before therapies or tools
modes.description: A field or topic word that leads into a noun like therapies or tools.
modes.example: As with other acute<< migraine>> therapies

card.writes: It promotes the plural noun services and similar words, and suppresses singular forms like service and tool, so it favors a plural generic noun next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a general noun like drugs, products or therapies, where the text refers to a group of items.
